name: Dotxy
summary: Found the 1.0.1 movement tech the current route depends on: dive/plunge (jump-attack) cancel on 10-14 and infinite double jump ("sanctum flight") on 10-21. His 1.0.1.2 Kuldra skip video has the exact inputs. He says a macro is not against the rules for single player. He also holds several glitchless Agility Course WRs.

insights.text:
You can cancel a jump attack by opening the spell casting menu, then selecting a spell that requires you to target an area on the ground. After you bring up the spell you can close the spell ring interface then jump!

you can repeat this in the air an infinite amount of times

video.title: Runescape Dragonwilds - 1.0.1 New Movement Tech - Infinite Double Jump

insights.verification_note: Reproduced by Nanobit (7:01), FastTipsGaming (console) and IINo1goodII (console).

insights.text:
definitely still works! make sure you have a weapon equipped that can perform a jump attack, on PC I have the magical mending spell keybind set to 1 on my keyboard so my inputs look like this:

Windstep/Double jump -> left click (jump attack) -> Q (open spell ring) -> 1 -> escape (close spell ring) -> Jump

repeat as needed with another jump attack etc

there's a bit of a rhythm to find with the inputs but it's not too bad

video.title: Runescape Dragonwilds - 1.0.1 New Movement Tech - Infinite Double Jump

insights.verification_note: Needs a weapon that can jump-attack. Nanobit notes the dragon scimitar has no plunge animation.

insights.text: there's no rules against using a macro for single player!

insights.verification_note: The SRC Raid rules (updated 2026-10-31) say nothing about macros. Ask the mods or the Discord before using one in a run.

recordings.description:
Heyo, here's a new way to get through Kuldra's Sanctum quick in the Runescape Dragonwilds 1.0.1.2 hotfix! You can check out the videos below to get the inputs i'm using.

Infinite Double Jumps - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=goKfbT19nkk

Dive Cancel - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LGCddmk_TnM

Feel free to set up a macro for easy infinite flight!


1.Windstep
2. Jump Attack
3. Q (Spell Ring)
4. [any targeted aoe spell]
5. Escape (closes Spell Ring interface)
6. Jump
Repeat steps 2-6 as needed!

This works mostly everywhere, happy flying friends

CHECK OUT THE SPEEDRUNNING SCENE THIS GAME RULES
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g1VvYZdR6ys

https://youtu.be/doVQ9Ph256g?si=_BTxDGPuIu8MBjHM
